sentences.text:
Respondent For Petitioner : Shri Kamleshwar Patel, Advocate For Respondent : Shri Rishabh Bisen, Panel Lawyer ({Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput}) Order on Board 13/09/2024 Challenge in this writ petition is to an order dated 02/08/2023 passed by respondent No.3 by which the petitioner,
who was working as Assistant Teacher (L.B.) in Government Primary School, Harijanpara, Block Development - Wadrafnagar, district - Balrampur - Ramanujganj, C.G. was placed under suspension on account of he being arrested in connection with crime No.102/23 registered under Section 419, 420, 201 IPC by Police Station - Raghnathpur.

sentences.text: Return has been filed by the respondents annexing order dated 31/07/2024 (Annexure R/1) by which the suspension of the petitioner vide order dated 02/08/2023 was revoked and he has been posted at Government Primary School, Pahadtola, Piproul, Block - Ramchandrapur, District - Balrampur - Ramanujganj (CG).
Since the suspension order of the petitioner has already been revoked, nothing remains for adjudication in this writ petition.
The petition is accordingly disposed of.
